=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.py:875-880 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: A matching branch can authorize a run for a reported PR even when server-fetched pull-request metadata identifies a different PR.
  WHY: The collector can fetch jobs, logs, and artifacts from the wrong failure run and misattribute them to the reported PR.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Verify every run against server-fetched source-issue or PR identity, head SHA, and workflow metadata before fetching evidence; skip runs that cannot be bound to the reported failure."
  expected_change_site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.py (_verify_run method and its caller wiring)
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  EVIDENCE: minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, and qwen_qwen3_7-plus report that the PR diff and changed-files list contain no production-code hunk for scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.py; minimax_minimax-m3 and qwen_qwen3_7-plus state the implementation exists on HEAD from merge commit e2bc27f, while deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro reports that the implementation is present on the PR head and that _verify_run and its caller validate the requested metadata, concluding the requirement is satisfied.
- requirement: "Recheck cached runs before reuse so unverified evidence is not retained" and "list unverifiable runs in the evidence index"
  expected_change_site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.py (the collect_run method's cached-run reuse path)
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  EVIDENCE: minimax_minimax-m3 and qwen_qwen3_7-plus report no PR diff hunk explicitly rechecking cached runs on run_head_mismatch, run_repo_mismatch, or run_no_verified_context; minimax_minimax-m3 notes the post-loop sweep removes the run directory and stale meta.json, while qwen_qwen3_7-plus says the new test assertion would fail without a source change; deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro reports _verify_run filters unverified runs before collect_run and post-collect cleanup removes rejected cached directories, citing test_same_repo_unrelated_run_is_skipped_before_jobs as coverage and concluding the requirement is satisfied.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.py: _verify_run, lines 878–879 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: The OR condition allows a run dispatched for one PR to pass verification for a different source PR that shares the same branch name and head SHA.
  WHY: The collector would fetch jobs, logs, and artifacts from the wrong failure run, producing heal evidence misattributed to the new PR.
- Requirement: "Verify every run against server-fetched source-issue or PR identity, head SHA, and workflow metadata before fetching evidence; skip runs that cannot be bound to the reported failure."
  Expected change site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.py (_verify_run and caller wiring)
  Evidence of absence: The implementation IS present on the PR head. The merge commit e2bc27f brought scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.py changes (131 lines) from claude/heal-evidence-bundle. The _verify_run method at line 852 validates source_repo identity, head_sha, branch/PR linkage, run metadata, repository match, and workflow name; the caller at line 1206 invokes it with the unverified_ reason prefix. The test additions in tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_evidence.py exercise same-repo skip-before-jobs, missing-head-skip, wrong-source-rejection, repo-mismatch, and timeline-hit paths. This requirement is satisfied.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Requirement: "Recheck cached runs before reuse so unverified evidence is not retained" and "list unverifiable runs in the evidence index, including cached runs"
  Expected change site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.py (collect_run cached path and collect cleanup)
  Evidence of absence: The cached-reuse path in collect_run (line 895–909) verifies only job-table completeness for review_only cached runs, not head/repo-matching after _verify_run already passes. However, _verify_run (line 852) runs first (line 1206) and filters out unverified runs before collect_run is called. The post-collect cleanup at lines 1234–1241 removes any run directory not in the keep set, including stale cached directories from runs that failed _verify_run. The test test_same_repo_unrelated_run_is_skipped_before_jobs (parametrized cached=True/False) asserts not stale.exists() after rejection. This requirement is satisfied.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.py: lines 879-880 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The verification accepts a run when only head_matches and branch_matches are true, even if server-fetched pull_requests lists a different PR number than source_number.
  WHY: An issue body that names source_number=6133 but links to a run whose pull_requests[0].number=7777 (a different PR with the same head_branch and head_sha) passes verification. The collector then fetches jobs, logs, and artifacts for the wrong failure as evidence.
- Requirement: The PR title and PR DESCRIPTION both state "AI implementation for issue #6334" and "Closes #6334". The linked issue's "Recommendation" requires the run-binding fix to land on scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.py near line 797.
  Expected change site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.py (_verify_run method and its caller wiring at the collect loop).
  Evidence of absence: pr_changed_files.txt and pr_diff.patch list only .ai/.workspace_source_manifest.txt, changelog.d/6334-heal-evidence-same-repo-run-binding.md, and tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_evidence.py. No hunk in either PR DIFF introduces _verify_run or modifies the existing caller at scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.py:1204-1212. The current working tree at HEAD does contain the implementation (lines 852-888), but it was not brought in by this PR's stated change set — it arrived via the merge commit e2bc27f from claude/heal-evidence-bundle (last_commit_stat.txt shows 131 insertions to that file). A reviewer auditing only the PR DIFF would conclude the deliverable is missing.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Requirement: The issue body requires the collector to "Recheck cached runs before reuse so unverified evidence is not retained" and to list unverifiable runs in the evidence index. The new test test_same_repo_unrelated_run_is_skipped_before_jobs asserts not stale.exists() after rejection.
  Expected change site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.py — the cached-run reuse path in collect_run (line 892 onwards) or a hook in collect that removes run_dir/meta.json for runs _verify_run rejects.
  Evidence of absence: collect_run only invalidates a cached entry when the cached jobs become unusable (unverified_run_not_failed at line 906); it does not delete a stale meta.json on run_head_mismatch / run_repo_mismatch / run_no_verified_context. The post-loop sweep at lines 1234-1241 does remove the entire run directory (and its meta.json) when the run was never added to keep_dirs, which is why the test's not stale.exists() assertion holds in this case — but the test's expectation is satisfied by a side-effect, not by an explicit "recheck cached runs" guard. The cached-only branch (a verified-by-timeline run whose cached meta.json is later invalidated by metadata drift) has no explicit re-check.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.py: 875-879, especially `if head_matches and (branch_matches or pr_linked or pr_named):` | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: A matching branch is accepted even when server-fetched pull_requests metadata identifies a different PR from the reported source PR.
  WHY: For a reported PR, a run with the same head SHA and branch but a different associated PR passes because branch_matches satisfies the OR condition. The collector then fetches that run’s jobs and logs as evidence for the wrong failure.
- Requirement: “Verify every run against server-fetched source-issue or PR identity, head SHA, and workflow metadata before fetching evidence; skip runs that cannot be bound to the reported failure.”
  Expected change site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.py, in _verify_run and its caller path.
  Evidence of absence: The provided PR diff and PR changed-files list contain no production-code hunk for scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.py; the task-specific diff adds tests, a changelog fragment, and manifest entries. The PR therefore does not include a production-code change delivering the requested verification.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.py: _verify_run, line 879 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: A matching branch is sufficient to accept a run even when server-fetched pull request metadata identifies a different PR from the reported source PR.
  WHY: If two PRs use the same head branch and SHA, a run linked to one PR passes verification for the other whenever the branch matches. The collector then fetches that run's jobs, logs, and artifacts as evidence for the wrong failure.
- Requirement: "Verify every run against server-fetched source-issue or PR identity, head SHA, and workflow metadata before fetching evidence; skip runs that cannot be bound to the reported failure."
  Expected change site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.py (the _verify_run method and its caller wiring)
  Evidence of absence: The PR CHANGED FILES list (.ai/.workspace_source_manifest.txt, changelog.d/6334-heal-evidence-same-repo-run-binding.md, tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_evidence.py) does not include scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.py. The PR DIFF contains only test additions, a changelog fragment, and a manifest update. The tests call _verify_run() and assert specific rejection reasons (run_no_verified_context, run_repo_mismatch, unverified_run_head_mismatch), but the production implementation of those checks is not present in the PR's own change set relative to the base branch. The merge-commit stat shows the file was touched (131 lines), indicating the implementation exists on the PR head from a merge, but the PR itself does not include the source fix the issue requires.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Requirement: The issue body requires the collector to "Recheck cached runs before reuse so unverified evidence is not retained" and to list unverifiable runs in the evidence index.
  Expected change site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.py (the collect_run method's cached-run reuse path)
  Evidence of absence: The PR DIFF adds a parameterized test (test_same_repo_unrelated_run_is_skipped_before_jobs with cached=True/False) that asserts not stale.exists() after rejection. The test exercises both cached and uncached paths. However, no diff hunk updates collect_run to delete the cached meta.json or otherwise re-verify on run_head_mismatch, run_repo_mismatch, or run_no_verified_context skip reasons. The current HEAD implementation only invalidates a cached entry on unverified_run_not_failed (line 906), not on the same-repo head/repo-mismatch reasons the new tests cover. Without an accompanying source change in the PR, the test's not stale.exists() assertion would fail.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
